machine_start_gcode:
; Geeetech official wiki homepage for A20M: https://www.geeetech.com/wiki/index.php/Geeetech_A20M_3D_printer 

M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; set extruder temp
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer[initial_no_support_extruder]] ; set bed temp
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer[initial_no_support_extruder]] ; wait for bed temp

G28 ; Home all axes first

; --- KLIPPER NATIVE ADAPTIVE MESH ---
; This automatically queries OrcaSlicer's object labels and shrinks the probe zone

BED_MESH_CALIBRATE ADAPTIVE=1 ADAPTIVE_MARGIN=5

M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; wait for extruder temp

SMART_PARK; Park Head to wait for temp

M220 S100 ; Reset Feedrate
M221 S100 ; Reset Flowrate
G92 E0 ; Reset Extruder
M107 ; Off Fan

;G1 Z5.0 F3000 ; Move Z Axis up little to prevent scratching of Heat Bed

T[initial_no_support_extruder] ; Choose initial filament for the first line

; --- ADAPTIVE PURGE CALL ---
;LINE_PURGE;   <-- Use this if you included KAMP_Settings.cfg

VORON_PURGE; <-- VORON LOGO




;LINE_PURGE;  <-- Adaptive purge

G92 E0 ; Reset Extruder
name: Geeetech A20 M 0.4 nozzle - klipper
